name: utility_carousel_loop
title: Utility Carousel Loop
description: Shared infinite-loop engine (like utility_slider is for sliders): renders any list of items in a row that scrolls forever. The JS duplicates the items once (aria-hidden, not focusable) so the CSS animation loops seamlessly; reduced motion / no JS = the items simply wrap, centered. Options: direction, speed, pause_on_hover, gap / gap_phone. Used by carousel_projects_items and taxonomy_marquee.
